column3: **Match the model to the job.** Before each spawn, start from the role's line or default and pick the reasoning level and speed the job needs. The `/setup-pstack` budget sets each role's starting level, xhigh by default. Raise it one step, up to max, for the hardest or subtlest work. Lower it one step for judgment and two or more steps for routine work. Use fast mode only when the job is urgent, meaning CI or trunk is red or a person is blocked on the result right now. Otherwise use standard speed, the same slug without `-fast`. Verification is the exception and stays on the `swarm workers` model and speed (`grok-4.7-xhigh-fast` by default). Change only the effort level and whether the slug is fast, and keep the family the role names, so a diverse panel stays diverse. If the family has no slug at that level and speed, use its nearest slug. A role on `auto` or `inherit-parent` stays on the parent model. If the Task tool rejects the adjusted slug, do not try another adjusted slug. Use the role's line or default and say so.
